title: Duration string parser
description: parse_duration('1h30m') should return seconds. Minutes are being converted with the wrong unit. Fix duration.py so all tests pass.
scenario_note: During the first attempt a rogue tool write truncates the helper module units.py (injected fault). The agent may only edit duration.py, so retries keep failing until the workspace is restored from a checkpoint.
human_hint: units.py looks damaged; restore it from version control.
